title: AccountStore + OAuthProvider + ZohoCorp Block + DcResolver
description: Implement the full account persistence layer, OAuth credential management, ZohoCorp domain hard-block, and datacenter URL resolver. This is the security-critical core story — all higher-level commands depend on it for account resolution, credential retrieval, and domain enforcement.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1 and 2 complete. IKeychainProvider, IOutputWriter, ZapiCliException, ErrorCodes all exist and compile. Program.cs DI wiring is in place.
goal: Produce a working AccountStore that persists AccountEntry records to accounts.json with correct permissions, a ZohoCorpGuard that unconditionally blocks ZohoCorp-domain accounts, a DcResolver that maps DC short names to Zoho Accounts URLs, and an OAuthProvider that stores/retrieves the full OAuth credential bundle (access_token + client_id + client_secret) as a single JSON blob in the OS keychain.
scope: Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/AccountEntry.cs as a sealed record: Name (required string), Dc (required string — 'us'|'eu'|'in'|'au'|'cn'|'jp'|'sa'|'uk'|'ca'), Email (string?), Zuid (string? — stored as 'zuidstring' in JSON), Scopes (List<string> = []), IsDefault (bool), NeedsReauth (bool). NO Token, ClientId, or ClientSecret properties — credentials are keychain-only.
Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/AccountsRoot.cs as a sealed record: Accounts (List<AccountEntry> = []).
Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/IAccountStore.cs: LoadAsync, SaveAsync, FindAsync(string name), GetDefaultAsync methods.

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/AccountStore.cs implementing IAccountStore: reads/writes accounts.json at <configDir>/accounts.json using System.Text.Json with SnakeCaseLower. On Unix sets 0600 via File.SetUnixFileMode. On Windows applies NTFS user-only ACL via FileSecurity (see OQ-007). GetDefaultAsync throws ZapiCliException(NO_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, 1) if no default account.

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Security/ZohoCorpGuard.cs: internal static class with static void AssertNotZohoCorp(string? email) — throws ZapiCliException('ZohoCorp accounts are not permitted.', ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED, 1) if email.Split('@')[1].Split('.')[0] equals 'zohocorp' (OrdinalIgnoreCase). If email is null or does not contain '@', passes (guard only blocks confirmed ZohoCorp, null is handled by EMAIL_REQUIRED at account add).

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Auth/DcResolver.cs: internal static class with static string GetAccountsBaseUrl(string dc) returning the Zoho Accounts base URL for the dc short name. Map: us→https://accounts.zoho.com, eu→https://accounts.zoho.eu, in→https://accounts.zoho.in, au→https://accounts.zoho.com.au, cn→https://accounts.zoho.com.cn, jp→https://accounts.zoho.jp, sa→https://accounts.zoho.sa, uk→https://accounts.zoho.uk, ca→https://accounts.zohocloud.ca. Throw ZapiCliException(INVALID_ARGS, 1) for unknown dc values.

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Auth/OAuthCredentials.cs: internal sealed record OAuthCredentials with required string AccessToken, required string ClientId, required string ClientSecret. Used exclusively for keychain JSON serialization/deserialization. Serialized with camelCase (NOT snake_case) since this is an internal format, not a user-visible output.

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Auth/IAuthProvider.cs: Task<string> GetTokenAsync(string accountName, CancellationToken ct = default); Task StoreTokenAsync(string accountName, string accessToken, string clientId, string clientSecret, CancellationToken ct = default); Task ClearTokenAsync(string accountName, CancellationToken ct = default); Task<string> RefreshTokenAsync(string accountName, IEnumerable<string> scopes, string dc, CancellationToken ct = default).

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Auth/OAuthProvider.cs implementing IAuthProvider. Constructor injects IKeychainProvider, IHttpClientFactory, ILogger<OAuthProvider>. Keychain key constant: private const string KeyPrefix = 'zapi-cli'; private static string MakeKey(string accountName) => $'{KeyPrefix}:{accountName}:oauth'.

OAuthProvider.GetTokenAsync: calls IKeychainProvider.GetAsync(MakeKey(accountName)). If null, throws ZapiCliException(KEYCHAIN_ERROR, 2). Deserializes JSON blob to OAuthCredentials and returns AccessToken.
OAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync: serializes { accessToken, clientId, clientSecret } to JSON and calls IKeychainProvider.SetAsync(MakeKey(accountName), json).
OAuthProvider.ClearTokenAsync: calls IKeychainProvider.DeleteAsync(MakeKey(accountName)). Swallows exceptions (best-effort cleanup during account remove).

OAuthProvider.RefreshTokenAsync: reads OAuthCredentials from keychain. POST form-encoded to DcResolver.GetAccountsBaseUrl(dc) + '/oauth/v2/token' with body: grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=<ClientId>&client_secret=<ClientSecret>&scope=<comma-joined scopes>. Parse JSON response for 'access_token'. If absent or HTTP error, throw ZapiCliException(AUTH_FAILURE, 2). Update keychain with new access_token (preserve client_id + client_secret). Return new access_token.
Register IAccountStore (AccountStore), IAuthProvider (OAuthProvider) as singletons in DI in Program.cs.

Unit tests: AccountStore round-trip (write/read/verify fields); ZohoCorpGuard blocks zohocorp.com, zohocorp.eu, zohocorp.com.au; ZohoCorpGuard passes example.com; ZohoCorpGuard passes null email (no throw); OAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync stores JSON blob; OAuthProvider.GetTokenAsync returns AccessToken from blob; DcResolver maps all 9 valid dc values; DcResolver throws on unknown dc.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
AccountEntry record has no token, client_id, or client_secret properties
AccountEntry.Zuid serializes as 'zuidstring' in JSON (matched by [JsonPropertyName("zuidstring")])
AccountStore.SaveAsync writes accounts.json with 0600 permissions on macOS/Linux
AccountStore round-trip: save AccountEntry, load it back, all fields match
OAuthProvider.GetTokenAsync with a valid stored blob returns the AccessToken string
OAuthProvider.GetTokenAsync with no keychain entry throws ZapiCliException(KEYCHAIN_ERROR, exit 2)
DcResolver maps 'us' → 'https://accounts.zoho.com' and all other 8 dc values correctly
contextForAgent: This story is security-critical. Read ADR-0003 for ZohoCorp block design — ZohoCorpGuard must be an internal static class in ZapiCli.Core.Security; it is NOT in ZapiCli. It must be called at BOTH account add (Story 4) AND api call/scope commands (Stories 5, 7). Read ADR-0002 for OAuthProvider design details including the keychain blob format and refresh flow. The keychain value is a JSON string (not a binary blob) — use camelCase property names internally: { 'accessToken': '...', 'clientId': '...', 'clientSecret': '...' }. ZapiCli.Core uses snake_case for user-visible output but camelCase for internal keychain serialization. Config directory: use Environment.GetFolderPath applied to ApplicationData on macOS/Linux + 'zapi-cli', LocalApplicationData on Windows + 'zapi-cli'.

openItems.defaultAssumption: Use Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.ApplicationData) on macOS/Linux. Use Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData) on Windows. Append 'zapi-cli' to get the config base dir. Create the directory if it does not exist.
See OQ-007. Use System.Security.AccessControl.FileSecurity. If ACL operation fails, log warning but do not fail the Save operation.
See OQ-002. Serialize OAuthCredentials with camelCase JsonSerializerOptions (distinct from the snake_case options used for user-visible output).
